meta.uncertainty: Empirical 10th–90th percentiles of 100 overlapping resampling runs, not confidence intervals. The two groups within each run are disjoint.
meta.first_example_selection: First seeded split; not chosen for a favorable result
meta.full_mean_usage: Context only, never a reference for the agreement metrics
meta.preprocessing_note: Author-processed data; no new filtering, ICA, trial rejection, channel interpolation or baseline correction. FIF header defaults are not processing-history evidence.
